concepts.def: Wordsworth and Coleridge revolution; 'language really used by men'; preface to 1800 edition manifesto.
Burke 1757 distinguished sublime (terror, vastness) from beautiful (delicacy); central to Romantic aesthetic.
Innocence's dark counterpart; 'Tyger' and 'London'; critique of institutional oppression.
Wonder year: Nightingale, Grecian Urn, Autumn, Melancholy, Psyche; 'negative capability' theory.
Poets as 'unacknowledged legislators of the world'; visionary politics; published posthumously 1840.
Autobiographical epic in blank verse; spots of time; growth of poet's mind; 1805 and 1850 versions.
